name: Woolly-leaf lupine
desc: Woolly-leaf lupine (Lupinus leucophyllus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 19 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lupinus leucophyllus is a species of lupine known by the common name velvet lupine. It is native to western North America, where it grows in many types of mountain, prairie, and plateau habitat.
